how_read: GitHub API releases of langwatch/langwatch (426 releases of app, SDKs, helm, mcp-server, langevals; 2024-06-03 to 2026-11-05), saved as one text file and shortlisted by keyword grep
comment: Read: sentiment evaluator, simulation cost/latency, TTFT (already recorded), langevals v3.0.0 and v3.1.0. Pre-2025 release bodies were only grepped (no metric names found beyond older evaluator, TTFT and sentiment items). Release notes are mostly PR titles. Deprecation: langevals v3.0.0 (2026-08-08) removed the legacy ragas_* evaluator types (breaking); their equivalents in the ragas/* family remain, so the recorded Ragas Faithfulness and Ragas Response Relevancy rows should be checked against the ragas/* names.

comment: The docs page https://langwatch.ai/docs/changelog only links to this file and lists no entries. Not proposed: thumbs_up_down event filters and sentiment.thumbs_up_down analytics (user-sent feedback events), coding-agent token usage on PR comments and PR cost split (cost already recorded), TTFT p95 column and TTFT capture (already recorded), dashboard/LangWatchQL items (user-built queries), scenario runs graded with evaluators (user-chosen evaluators). langevals CHANGELOG.md and the app-level CHANGELOG at the paths tried returned 404.
